deco.css: .fd-lantern{position:fixed;top:1.4vh;right:4vw;width:2.6vw;height:4.4vh;border-radius:50% 50% 48% 48% / 46% 46% 54% 54%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 30%,rgba(255,206,150,.95),rgba(184,39,42,.85) 66%,rgba(120,26,28,.9));box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(224,110,60,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(224,180,74,.35);opacity:.9;animation:fd-glow 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}.fd-cap{position:fixed;top:0.4vh;right:3.6vw;width:3.4vw;height:0.9vh;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(224,180,74,.6),rgba(224,180,74,.25),rgba(224,180,74,.6));pointer-events:none}.fd-window{position:fixed;bottom:2.4vh;left:3vw;width:1.9vw;height:1.9vw;border-radius:2px;border:2px solid rgba(184,39,42,.35);background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(184,39,42,.18),rgba(184,39,42,0) 68%);transform:rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}@keyframes fd-glow{from{opacity:.7}to{opacity:1}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.fd-lantern{animation:none}}
